Product:{\"sku\":\"7100129565\"}.name: WACKY! DEER & MUNK ADVENTURE
Product:{\"sku\":\"7100129565\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
WACKY! Deer & Munk Adventure is a 2D side-scrolling action adventure built for solo players and co-op chaos alike. Play as Deer and Munk, two completely different characters whose wildly unique abilities make every stage feel like a fresh challenge. The art style is hard to explain and impossible to forget: rough around the edges, full of personality, and weirdly, completely adorable. Think animated stickers come to life. Once it gets you, it does not let go.

・Characters you will not find anywhere else: Deer and Munk look like they wandered out of a doodle notebook and straight into your heart. Odd, charming, and 100% addictive.
・Deer brings the muscle: dash, high jump, move heavy objects, and swing weapons. Munk brings the finesse: double jump, glide, and slip through passages Deer could never fit through.
・Neither character can win without the other. This is true co-op, not just "player 2 tags along."
・10 wildly distinct world maps and 200+ stages that never stop throwing something new at you.
・Unlock a new comic strip with its own unique story every time you clear a specific stage!
・Two separate storylines for solo play and co-op. Experience the adventure from both perspectives!
・A difficulty curve that grows with you, with fresh environments and surprises keeping every session exciting.
・Some moments demand perfect sync: press together, move together, think together. Friendship will be tested.
・Hundreds of unlockable costume pieces for heads, faces, outfits, and dances. Make your Deer and Munk completely your own.
・Upgrade items at the shop to power through even the toughest stages by force!
・200+ post-game challenges and hidden secrets. Finishing the story is just the beginning.
・Play on your TV, at the table, or on the go. TV Mode, Tabletop Mode, and Handheld Mode all fully supported.
・A soundtrack and sound design that makes the whole world feel alive.

Grab a friend, grab a Joy-Con™, and jump into the most unexpectedly lovable co-op adventure on Nintendo Switch™. Solo players, you are covered too. With 200+ stages full of hidden secrets and surprises, every run has something new waiting. Can you find everything? The only way to know is to start playing.

Prologue
On a quiet autumn day, the acorn village was full of joy. Piled high in the center of town were mountains of precious acorns, gathered one by one over the course of an entire year by every villager working side by side. They were more than just food. They were hope for surviving the bitter winter ahead, a treasure filled with the sweat and smiles of every single neighbor.

But the joy did not last long. Without warning, a thunderous roar shook the village. The Pig King's army came crashing in, trampling everything in their path. The ruthless soldiers swept through without mercy and carried off every last acorn. Not one was left behind. When the dust settled, only despair and fear remained.

The villagers stood in silence, heads low. Then one small figure stood up. Munk was the tiniest one in the whole village. But no one had a braver heart. It wasn't that there was no fear. But the tears on every neighbor's face made it impossible to stay still.

On the long road ahead, Munk finds an unexpected companion: Deer. Big, warm-hearted, and somehow delightfully oblivious to most things. The two could not be more different in personality or ability, and at first they bump heads constantly. But somewhere along the way, walking side by side, they both realize the same thing: neither one can do this without the other.

The road back to the acorns is long and full of danger. The Pig King's forces lurk around every corner, and unknown lands stretch out ahead where neither of them has ever been. But that is okay.

"Can't do it alone. Together, we absolutely can!"

The funny, goofy, and surprisingly heartwarming grand adventure of Deer and Munk begins right now!
